description: Plate-reader exports, with the layout the file stores or `layout`. analysis: wells (per-well values, blank subtraction, replicate mean/SD/CV, outliers), curve (standard curve, back-calculated concentrations, LLOQ/ULOQ), dose-response (IC50/EC50 per compound with CI and Hill slope), kinetics (Vmax, lag, AUC per well), growth (growth rate, doubling time, lag, logistic fit, and whether each well grew, crashed or regrew, with times), qc (Z′, S/B, S/N, SSMD). An argument that names analyses applies to those only.

blank_subtraction.description: Blank subtraction. Default `auto`. `auto` = the mean of the blank wells when there are blanks; `mean` = the mean of the blank wells (an error without blanks); `median` = the median of the blank wells (an error without blanks); `none` = nothing.

embedded_layout.description: Use the layout the export embeds (Gen5 Well ID and Conc/Dil, SkanIt Sample, BMG Content/Concentration). Default true.

exclude_outliers.description: Leave flagged outliers out of means, fits and controls. Default false (flag only).

layout_text.description: Plate layout as CSV/TSV text (instead of, or on top of, `layout`).

outlier_threshold.description: Outlier threshold: alpha (`grubbs`, default 0.05) or modified z-score cut-off (`mad`, default 3.5).

outliers.description: Outlier rule within a replicate group. Default `grubbs`. `grubbs` = two-sided Grubbs' test at alpha = threshold (0.05), one outlier per group of 3+ wells; `mad` = modified z-score |0.6745 (x − median) / MAD| > threshold (3.5), groups of 5+ wells; `none` = no flagging.

read.description: Read to analyse: its 1-based number or its label. Default: the first measured read.

roles.description: Role of wells by the name the layout gives them: `{"DMSO": "negative", "STAU": "positive"}`.

table.description: Table (plate) index of the export (see openreadout_info → tables[]). Default 0.

wavelength_nm.description: For spectral reads: the wavelength (nm) to analyse.

analysis.description: What to compute. `wells` = Per-well and per-replicate-group values: roles, blank subtraction, mean, SD, CV %, outliers; `curve` = Standard curve (linear, 4PL, 5PL) and back-calculated concentrations of every well; `dose-response` = Dose-response per compound: IC50/EC50 with confidence interval, Hill slope, top, bottom; `kinetics` = Per-well kinetic metrics: max slope (Vmax), lag time, time to max, AUC; `growth` = Per-well growth curves: growth rate, doubling time, lag, logistic fit; which wells grew, crashed or regrew and when (growth_summary); `qc` = Assay quality from control wells: Z′, signal/background, signal/noise, CVs.

confidence.description: curve, dose-response: confidence level of intervals. Default 0.95.

fields.description: Rows show their main fields to 4 significant digits (growth: pattern, growth_rate_per_h, doubling_time_h, lag_time_s, max_value, time_to_max_s, crash_s, trough_s, regrowth_s). fields adds others, e.g. `["auc_h", "logistic_k"]`; `["all"]`: every field, full precision.

file.description: Path to the file or data-set directory.

fit_on.description: curve: fit every standard replicate or the level means. Default `replicates`. `replicates` = Every standard well (replicates as separate points); `means` = The mean of each standard level.

growth_threshold.description: growth: values at or below this are left out of the log-scale fit. Default 5 % of each well's maximum.

layout.description: Plate-layout file: CSV/TSV, a plate-map grid (blocks whose corner cell names the field: role, sample, compound, concentration, dilution) or a long table with a `well` column.

lloq.description: curve: lower limit of quantification (overrides the recovery rule).

model.description: curve, dose-response: the model. Default `4pl`. `linear` = y = slope · x + intercept; `4pl` = Four-parameter logistic: y = d + (a − d) / (1 + (x/c)^b); `5pl` = Five-parameter logistic: y = d + (a − d) / (1 + (x/c)^b)^g.

negative_wells.description: Wells to mark as negative controls (no effect / vehicle).

normalize.description: wells, dose-response, qc: percent effect from the controls. Default `none`. `none` = the (blank-subtracted) signal; `controls` = percent effect: 0 % = the negative control (vehicle) mean, 100 % = the positive control mean.

plot.description: curve, dose-response: also return a PNG of the points and the fitted curve.

positive_wells.description: Wells to mark as positive controls (full effect / maximum signal).

reduce.description: wells, curve, dose-response, qc on a kinetic read: how each well's time course becomes one value. `first` = first time point; `last` = last time point; `max` = largest value; `min` = smallest value; `mean` = mean over all time points; `max-slope` = largest slope over `window` points, per minute; `mean-slope` = least-squares slope over all time points, per minute; `auc` = area under the curve (value × s).

standards.description: curve: standards as `WELLS=CONCENTRATION` items separated by `;` (`A1,A2=100;B1:B2=50`). Default: the layout's.

strict.description: Refuse values the file's assurance does not validate (exit_code 6). Default: the server's.

uloq.description: curve: upper limit of quantification (overrides the recovery rule).

weighting.description: curve, dose-response: fit weighting. Default `none`. `none` = Every point weight 1 (ordinary least squares); `1/y` = w = 1/|y|; `1/y2` = w = 1/y²; `1/x` = w = 1/x (x > 0); `1/x2` = w = 1/x² (x > 0).

wells.description: Only these wells (`A1:H6`); the layout's blanks and controls are still used.

window.description: Points per sliding window (reduce=max-slope, kinetics, growth). Default: 5 or a tenth of the time points, whichever is larger.

name: openreadout_assay

per_time_point.description: Whether the blank was subtracted per time point.

value.description:
The value subtracted (endpoint), or its mean over time points (kinetic: subtracted per
time point).

absolute_ec50.description: Concentration where the fitted curve crosses 50 % effect (`normalize: controls`).

ec50.description: Concentration at the curve's midpoint (the 4PL/5PL parameter c).

ec50_ci_low.description: Lower confidence limit of `ec50`, from ln(c) ± t·SE(ln c).

hill_slope.description: Hill slope, GraphPad sign convention: positive when the response rises with dose.

label.description: Well (replicate fits) or group (fits on means).

concentration_unit.description: Unit of the concentrations, when the layout states one.

formula.description: The formula in the parameter names.

parameters.description: Parameters with standard errors and confidence limits.

points.description: The points with fitted values and residuals.

GroupStats.description: Statistics of a group of control wells.

auc_h.description: Trapezoidal area under the curve (value × h).

background.description:
The well's own minimum, subtracted as background when the layout has no blank wells
(growthcurver's default); absent when blanks were subtracted or subtraction is off.

crash_s.description: Time of the high point before the crash (s).

exp_phase_after_crash.description:
The exponential phase lies after the crash (`regrew` wells): the growth rate and
doubling time are those of the regrowth.

exp_phase_end_s.description: Last time of the exponential phase (s).

exp_phase_start_s.description: First time of the exponential phase (s).

exp_r_squared.description: r² of ln(value) against time in the exponential phase.

group.description: Replicate group (the layout's group, else the sample name).

growth_rate_per_h.description: Maximum specific growth rate µmax (per hour).

logistic_k.description: Logistic fit (wells whose pattern is `grew`): carrying capacity K.

logistic_n0.description: Logistic fit: N0 at the first time point.

pattern.description:
What the curve did: `grew`, `no_growth`, `crashed` (fell to half its height and stayed
down) or `regrew` (fell, then grew again).

regrowth_s.description: When growth restarts after the crash (s): the lag time of the regrowth.

threshold.description: Values at or below this were left out of the log-scale fit.

trough_s.description: Time of the lowest point after the crash (s).

window.description: Points per window of the log-scale fit.

GrowthSummary.description: The growth patterns of the wells analysed.

crash_s.description: Crash times over the `crashed` and `regrew` wells (s): smallest, median, largest.

regrowth_s.description: Regrowth times over the `regrew` wells (s): smallest, median, largest.

wells.description: Wells per pattern (`grew`, `no_growth`, `crashed`, `regrew`), in plate order.

auc.description: Trapezoidal area under the curve (value × s).

max_slope_per_min.description: Largest windowed slope, value units per minute (Vmax).

mean_slope_per_min.description: Least-squares slope over all points, value units per minute.

time_at_max_slope_s.description: Mean time of the max-slope window (s).

window_end_s.description: Last time of the max-slope window (s).

window_start_s.description: First time of the max-slope window (s).

concentration_unit.description: Unit of the concentrations, when the layout states one.

roles.description: Measured wells per role (`unassigned` for wells the layout does not name).

sources.description:
Sources merged, in order (later ones win well by well): `embedded:<title>`, a file path,
`text`, `--blank-wells`, ….

excluded.description: Whether flagged wells were left out of means, fits and controls.

QualityReport.description: Assay quality of the plate (values as read, before blank subtraction).

median_replicate_cv_percent.description: Median CV % over replicate groups of two or more wells.

signal_to_background.description: Higher control mean / lower control mean.

ssmd.description: Strictly standardized mean difference (mean pos − mean neg) / √(SDpos² + SDneg²).

z_prime.description: Z′ = 1 − 3 (SDpos + SDneg) / |mean pos − mean neg| (Zhang, Chung & Oldenburg 1999).

calculated.description: Values the vendor software calculated (not measured).

kinetic.description: Whether the read has several time points per well.

label.description: Label as the file writes it.

back_calculated_cv_percent.description: `curve`: CV % of the wells' back-calculated concentrations.

back_calculated_mean.description: `curve`: mean of the wells' back-calculated concentrations.

back_calculated_of_mean.description: `curve`: concentration back-calculated from the group's mean signal.

back_calculated_sd.description: `curve`: SD of the wells' back-calculated concentrations.

group.description: Group name (the sample name, else role and concentration, else the well).

metric.description:
What `mean`/`sd`/`cv_percent` summarise: `value` (blank-subtracted), or a kinetic/growth
metric (`max_slope_per_min`, `doubling_time_h`).

back_calculated.description: Concentration back-calculated from the standard curve (`curve`).

excluded.description: Left out of means and fits.

flag.description:
`curve`: `in_range`, `below_range`, `above_range` (outside the standards'
concentrations), `below_curve`, `above_curve` (beyond an asymptote: no concentration) or
`not_computable`.

group.description: Replicate group this well belongs to.

outlier.description: Flagged as an outlier in its replicate group.

raw.description:
The value as read (after `reduce` for kinetic reads); null when the cell was not a
number.

value.description: After blank subtraction (equal to `raw` without one).

format.description: Format id of the input (`plate`, or `long-csv`).

growth_summary.description: Wells by growth pattern, with the range of crash and regrowth times (`growth`).

layout.description: Where the layout came from and what it assigns.

notes.description: What was assumed or left out.

quality.description: Assay quality from control wells (whenever positive and negative controls exist).

reduce.description: How kinetic time courses were reduced to one value per well (endpoint analyses).

samples.description: One row per replicate group (sample, standard level, control, dose).

warnings.description:
What may be wrong with the layout: role names read as samples, controls of unknown sign,
role-map entries that matched no well.
